rationale: GPN has collapsed roughly 12% from its prior close, trading near the low of its range (9.1% position) with only 14 minutes until forced liquidation at market close. The 5-minute ATR of ~$0.52 is too small relative to any meaningful stop placement given the extreme intraday volatility, and the last five 1-minute candles show a slow, directionless drift with no clear momentum signal to exploit in the remaining time. The risk/reward of entering a position that must be closed at market in 14 minutes, in a stock that has already made its large move, does not justify committing capital.
